programs.6502:
DEVICE EATER6502
PIN led = PA0 OUTPUT
WHEN flag clicked:
  set counter to 40000
  change counter by -5
  REPEAT 3:
    change counter by 1
  IF counter > 100 THEN:
    turn on led
  print counter

WHEN flag clicked:
  set other to 7
  REPEAT other:
    turn off led
    wait 0.01 seconds
